outcome: Surgical indicators (bleeding, operation time, hospitalization expenses, hospital stay)
Clinical efficacy (menstrual period before and after surgery, recurrence outcome, pregnancy outcome)
cohort: 65 patients who underwent surgery for uterine cesarean section scar diverticulum at Gansu Provincial Maternity and Child-care Hospital from 1 January 2013 to 31 February 2019
finding: The three surgical methods are effective for treating cesarean section scar diverticulum with favorable effects, but laparoscopic combined with hysteroscopic surgery is minimally invasive with less bleeding compared with the other two techniques and it is easier for patients to accept.
